notes.text: The notice points from יוסתאי בר מתון, Yostai bar Matun, to דוסתאי, Dostai. It supplies a cross-reference, not an independent identity argument; bar is preserved.
The source heading was recorded as provisional; this publication follows the supplied text without a new print-reading claim.
